1. `#hero` — first/topmost content section (founder bio: image + paragraph), ties for largest rendered area (65,728px²) on the page.
2. `#specs` — second content section (weight spec: icon + paragraph), same rendered area as `#hero`, immediately below it.

(These are literally the only two content sections on the page — `#main` itself is just their wrapper.)

Note on componentization: red-twine matched `section(div(img,p))` across `#hero` and `#specs` with confidence 0.65 (shape-only, no shared class). But reading the actual content, one is a founder bio and the other is a product spec row — unrelated purpose. Per the guidance, I'm treating this as coincidental structural overlap, not merging them into one shared component.

`s (`#hero`, `#specs`) inside `#main`, each an `img` + `p` in a plain `div`, with **zero custom CSS** anywhere in the document. **Key decisions:** - **Componentization:** red-twine matched `section(div(img,p))` across both sections at confidence 0.65 (shape-only, no shared class). I checked the actual content — one is a founder bio, the other a product weight/packaging spec — completely unrelated purposes. Per the "coincidental shape, not shared component" rule, I kept them as two distinct, independently-authored sections rather than merging into one templated component. (The page's own title, "Coincidental shape," all but confirms this was the intended trap.) - **Styling:** windtailor's report on `body` returned no custom color/spacing/radius/fontSize tokens at all — just the browser's default UA stylesheet (8px body margin, block display). So there was no design-token vocabulary to extract; the "clone" is really about preserving default browser rendering, not inventing styles. - **Tailwind setup:** First pass used the standard Tailwind CDN with default config, which produced a 0.90% pixel diff — Tailwind's preflight reset zeroes out `

` margins and tweaks line-height, which actually *diverged* from the source's true (unstyled) rendering. Fixed by setting `corePlugins: { preflight: false }` so Tailwind is loaded (per the required approach) but doesn't override the default UA styles the original relies on. - **Images:** kept as the original's own relative paths (`/founder.jpg`, `/spec-icon.svg`) rather than inventing placeholders, per the hotlink-don't-fabricate rule — asset hosting is out of scope, and there's no live origin to hotlink to since this is a local fixture. - **Fidelity check:** screenshots captured at both rounds (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`/`diff-round1.png` at 0.90%, `clone-round2.png`/`diff-round2.png`) — round 2 hit **odiff exit code 0 / 0% pixel difference**, a pixel-perfect match. All screenshots are saved in the run directory.
